name: Liuzhou Iron&Steel Co., Ltd
summary: Liuzhou Iron&Steel Co., Ltd produces and sells iron and steel products. It offers carbon steel plates; profiles; plates; billets; chemical products; gas; low alloy steel plates; steel plates without trimming; steel plates for molds; ship plates; boiler and pressure vessel plates; bridge plates; steel plates; pipeline steel; automotive girder plates; high-rise buildings; steel plates for automobiles; steel wire rods; cold rolled steel; galvanized steel; hot rolled steel strips; pickled plates, medium and thick plates, ribbed steel bars, high-speed wire rods, and medium-sized steel and other products. The company is also involved in ferrous metal smelting and rolling processing; steel rolling;…
